label: Defence
description: The armed forces, weapons procurement and the atomic programme. Counts as government purchases; part is spent at overseas bases and leaves the country.

label: Foreign aid
description: The Marshall Plan and other international programmes. Much of it is spent on American goods, so it props up exports.

label: Welfare and veterans
description: Veterans' benefits, public assistance and social security. Paid to households, so it lifts disposable income and consumption. Unemployment insurance is paid automatically on top.

label: Infrastructure
description: Roads, dams, power and public works. Adds to demand now and builds public capital that raises productive capacity for decades.

label: Research
description: Civilian and military-adjacent science. Adds to public capital now; will feed the technology trees in Phase 3.

label: Education and health
description: Federal grants for schools, hospitals and public health. Adds to public capital now; will shape pops' skills and health in Phase 3.

label: General government
description: Running the federal government: agriculture programmes, justice, administration.
